vertex-3.8-global-shared.basis: Published standard rates before promotional credits. Image tokens are included in input; response and reasoning tokens are output. Reservations assume no cache discount. No grounding, search, explicit cache storage, tuned models, priority, provisioned throughput, or other separately billed tools are covered.

fx.basis: ECB reference cross-rate, SGD per EUR divided by USD per EUR, rounded upward to 12 decimal places. A reference estimate, not the account's Cloud SGD SKU price or settlement rate.
